name: Jhon Wilfred Drio

personal.note: Age is computed from birthDate at answer time.

title: System and Automation Engineer / Technical Manager
companyDescription: Korean medical supplies distributor in the Philippines, exclusive Philippine distributor for Sungshim and Insufine
availability: Open to full-time, freelance, and contract roles
tagline: Systems that work. For people who do.
philosophy: In every workplace there is a system that technically exists and a separate, informal process people actually use. I study that gap and redesign the system around real behavior, not org-chart assumptions. I use the right tool for the operation, not the most impressive-sounding one.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

experience.role: System and Automation Engineer / Technical Manager
experience.summary: Owns the full lifecycle of the company's internal systems: workflow discovery, requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, controlled releases, recovery documentation, and staff support.
Operated high-volume multifunction printing systems and production records.
Customer-facing operations; became the go-to person for technical troubleshooting.
Managed online orders, warehouse operations, and shipments.
Facilitated online classes and e-documents during the pandemic.
Daily operations in a busy school canteen.

systems.name: K-Pick ERP-lite
systems.status: Production, running in parallel validation with the company's official records
systems.stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, vanilla JavaScript, launchd on a Mac mini
systems.metrics: 133 API routes, 30 schema migrations, 52 data models, 33 module views, 100 test files, 209 commits since June 2026
systems.summary: Inventory, operations, and finance platform: product master with unit conversion, append-only stock ledger with FEFO (first-expiry-first-out) allocation, Shopee / Lazada / TikTok Shop imports with mapping and duplicate prevention, order management with barcode checking, a phone-based packing scanner, multi-user count sessions, returns with condition and expiry, purchase planning, a multi-platform Finance Board, staff KPIs, customer statements, installation job orders, and configurable roles. Deployed with a guarded deploy script, pre-migration backups, health-check gates, and one-command rollback.

systems.name: Accounting and BIR Computerized Accounting System module
systems.status: Shipped 2026-09-06 as a parallel module inside ERP-lite
systems.stack: Same ERP-lite stack; PostgreSQL triggers and constraints
systems.metrics: 6 BIR document types, 8 migrations in one release, independent numbering series per sales channel
systems.summary: Built for a Bureau of Internal Revenue Computerized Accounting System application: sales invoices with gapless per-series serial numbers, senior-citizen and PWD tax-exempt math, void-not-edit with reprint marking, a specimen print mode, the six-document set (sales invoice, collection receipt, credit and debit memo, purchase order, receiving report), chart of accounts, journal with a database-level balance constraint, general ledger, trial balance, sales journal, landed cost frozen per shipment and consumed FIFO, marketplace payout reconciliation, and an audit log that is append-only at the database level with a viewer supporting filters, print, and CSV export.

systems.name: K-PICK HRIS
systems.stack: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, React 18, TypeScript, Vite
systems.metrics: 23 route modules, 188 API endpoints, 22 pure service modules, 28 React pages, 43 test files, 12 migrations
systems.summary: Standalone Philippine HR, timekeeping, and payroll system: 201 records, biometric attendance import, day-type and night-differential resolution, request-based overtime and rest-day authorization, failure-to-swipe corrections, statutory leave types, versioned SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG / withholding-tax tables, a pure payroll engine that rounds once to the centavo, A5 payslip PDFs, 13th-month and final-pay computation, recruitment, appraisals, disciplinary cases under the twin-notice rule, and an employee self-service portal. Role-based pay visibility keeps amounts away from HR while accounting sees the computed payslip.

systems.name: KORA
systems.stack: Python, python-telegram-bot, PostgreSQL, Ollama with a local Qwen 2.5 14B model, scheduled jobs in Philippine time
systems.metrics: 10 Telegram commands, 8 scheduled jobs, about 5,600 lines across 8 modules, first commit 2026-07-01, hatched as a desktop mascot 2026-08-26
systems.summary: Reads the ERP database for a 7 PM daily operations report, assembles Jhon's daily associate report from git commits, an idempotent developer-report feed, and manual /mytask notes, monitors system health every 10 minutes while he is off-site, answers questions through an on-premise model with an application-level identity guard, and routes sensitive figures to private recipients only. Fails closed on malformed input and claims delivery only with evidence. Commands include /report, /today, /shipment, /status, /ask, /mytask, /dayoff, /away, /error, and /nespresso.

systems.name: Shopee Dispatch Display System
systems.stack: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Web Audio API, JSON persistence
systems.metrics: 5-stage order lifecycle, 5-stage picklist pipeline, 5 audio alert types
systems.summary: Real-time dispatch board with two synced browser views. Office staff dispatch rider codes and create picklists; the packing display shows large order cards with audio alerts and a flashing RUSH banner for nudged orders. State persists through restarts with atomic writes.

systems.name: kpicktradingcorp.com
systems.status: Live public B2B website on Hostinger
systems.stack: Static HTML, hand-written Node.js backend with SQLite, PDF generation, SMTP email
systems.metrics: 21 pages, 9 Sungshim product pages, Schema.org data on 15 pages, 116 commits
systems.summary: Branded PDF quotations emailed to buyers, a quote-to-purchase-order workflow with role-based staff logins, published manufacturer certificates, a Learning Centre of interactive device infographics, brand films that load only in view, sellable stock and box prices synced from the ERP every 15 minutes, security hardening with timing-safe auth and rate limits, and llms.txt plus an AI-crawler policy for answer engines.

systems.name: Excel VBA tools
systems.summary: An ordering system with form validation and an audit log, an attendance checker with automated calculations and summary reports, and a Sudoku built to explore the limits of VBA.
